'''Noel Burns''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Iowa State Championship]] on 5 May 2001 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|TDIGWATT]], according to Seth Van Winkle's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2482">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-19-seth-ownz-you-almost-iowa-states-2k1d2482/ seth-ownz-you-almost-iowa-states-2k1], DeckTech (Seth "Ooryl" Van Winkle, 19 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-19-seth-ownz-you-almost-iowa-states-2k1d2482/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
